info.title: FS-Platform API
info.description: Ind AS financial statement preparation and review platform. Every endpoint requires an authenticated, MFA-verified session (cookie `fs_session`) and the `X-CSRF-Token` header for unsafe methods, except the login / invite / password-reset flows, the sign-in options, the desktop edition's first-run setup and the internal render-worker protocol (`X-Worker-Token`).

get.description: Public: what the sign-in screens offer. ``setup_required`` sends a fresh desktop installation to /setup.

post.description:
Confirm privileged actions for a few minutes (E-SEC-03): the authenticator code, or the password where this
installation requires no authenticator.

schema.title: Response My Sessions Api V1 Auth Sessions Get

post.description:
"Create an account" (desktop edition). The account is signed in at once but has no role, so it sees no client
until an administrator assigns one (Admin → Assignments); administrators find it on Admin → Users.
Also the forced change after a one-time password (the only data endpoint served until it is done).
Create the firm (roles, permission matrix, policies, audit head) and its Firm Admin. Once only: 409 afterwards.

schema.title: Response List Users Api V1 Admin Users Get

post.description: Offboarding: disabling revokes every session immediately; history is kept (05 §1).
MFA reset is admin-only (08 §3), with step-up and a reason.

A reset link to hand over in person (no e-mail on the desktop edition). Step-up and a reason, like the MFA reset;
the user chooses the new password on the reset page, which signs out their sessions.

put.description:
``works_on_engagements``: a Firm Admin who creates a client is also made its Partner. That weakens segregation of
duties, so changing it needs step-up and a reason; each such assignment is audited and flagged in access reviews.

schema.title: Response List Roles Api V1 Admin Roles Get

put.description: Edit the matrix (05 §2: editable by Firm Admin) — step-up + reason, fully audited.

schema.title: Response List Assignments Api V1 Admin Assignments Get
Response List Elevations Api V1 Admin Elevations Get

post.description: Time-boxed elevation approved by a *different* admin; alerts on use (E-SEC-03).

schema.title: Response List Policies Api V1 Admin Policies  Name  Get

put.description: Publish a new ABAC policy version (policies are versioned data, E-SEC-02).

get.description: Per-client monthly usage (D7 billing basis, E-BIZ-01).
E-RULE-01: registered, versioned rules; every run records the rule-set version it used.

schema.title: Response Health Api V1 Health Get

post.description: Imports always land in a quarantined engagement; a Partner promotes it (07 §5).
A Manager confirms the conflicting branch was reconciled (E-DATA-05).
